mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, consistently producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 225.0 signals inflationary pressure that triggers monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when the threshold is crossed.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 225.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate strong labor market dynamics that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of PAYEMS (increasing) and UNRATE (decreasing) fails to produce positive 5d returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime, a decline in UNRATE below 9.0% signals improving labor market conditions that increase consumer confidence and corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 9.0% in a high unemployment regime.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) levels indicate robust residential construction demand, which serves as a leading indicator of economic expansion and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 600.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 100 (base year 2017) signals sustained manufacturing growth that correlates with strong corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer demand regime, RSAFS exceeding 400,000 indicates strong retail activity that drives corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 400,000 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of low FEDFUNDS and low UNRATE indicates favorable monetary and labor market conditions that compress risk premiums, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint low FEDFUNDS and low UNRATE condition fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
